task: While importing the Trivy DBs into the live single-node Vagrant cluster, fix two defects: MetalLB not announcing the LB IP on NARWHAL_TOPOLOGY=single, and push-security-db.sh not honouring --ca-cert for skopeo copy.

events.summary: single-only removal of node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers in 02-init-cluster.sh, 06-phase2-start.sh and cluster-heal.sh; one argument in push-security-db.sh; R344, an R303 mutation, a verify-cluster check, operations.md and two lessons-log rows. Left alone: ha behaviour, the host kubeconfig and keychain, the airgap bundle contents (R19, issue #663).

Measured on the live single cluster: host ARP for 192.168.56.200 incomplete and https to harbor.local.narwhal.internal timing out while in-guest access worked; the node carried the exclusion label. Separately, push-security-db.sh --ca-cert failed 0/3 with 'certificate is not trusted' at skopeo copy although login succeeded; skopeo inspect trusted the CA with a flat cert dir and not with a certs.d parent (skopeo 1.24.1).
Remove the label when the topology is single (init, Phase 2, heal); pass ${CERTDIR}/${SECDB_REGISTRY} as --dest-cert-dir.

events.scope: Static suite including R344 and R303; the label-removal command and the patched push script run by hand against the live cluster. NOT covered: a fresh single provision with the changed scripts, an ha provision.
evidence: test:kubectl label node narwhal-master-1 node.kubernetes.io/exclude-from-external-load-balancers- -> host ARP resolved, Harbor /v2/ 401 from the host
test:push-security-db.sh --ca-cert with the fix -> Pushed: 3 | Failed: 0

events.summary: Both fixes are in the repository and their effect was measured on the live cluster by hand; the provisioning path that applies the label removal automatically is covered only statically.
Complete within the verified scope; independent review pending.
